entities.name: Mobile station classmark 2
entities.description: Information element indicating UE capabilities related to SRVCC and vSRVCC support or used during combined attach procedures.

entities.name: UE supports SRVCC to GERAN or UTRAN
entities.description: Condition where the UE supports SRVCC handover to GERAN or UTRAN networks.

entities.name: UE supports vSRVCC to UTRAN
entities.description: Condition where the UE supports vSRVCC handover to UTRAN networks.

entities.name: UE performing combined attach procedure
entities.description: Condition where the UE is executing a combined EPS and non-EPS attach procedure.

relations.description: Mobile station classmark 2 IE inclusion is required if UE supports SRVCC to GERAN or UTRAN.
Mobile station classmark 2 IE inclusion is required if UE supports vSRVCC to UTRAN.
Mobile station classmark 2 IE inclusion is required if UE is performing a combined attach procedure.
